inventory.visible_alpha: Target layer alpha times product(1-alpha) of all nearer layers; numeric depth only verifies target identity
inventory.click_rule: Largest8-connected component, exact Euclidean distance with zero-padded image boundary, maximal margin; ties row-major

protocol.name: Target-guided Point-Focus Adapter
protocol.target_visibility: Designated target layer alpha times all nearer-layer transmittances; metadata identifies the same source object on each frame
protocol.click_region: Visible alpha>0.9; if empty >0.5; if empty >0; largest8-connected component; zero-padded exact Euclidean distance; ties row-major
protocol.A: Maximal interior distance, independent of predicted depth
protocol.B_diagnostic_only: Native PNG8 depth nearest safe-region median; ties maximal interior distance then row-major
protocol.unavailable: Mark focus_point_unavailable; no substitution, propagation, smoothing or exclusion policy before inventory
protocol.depth: Official DAdepth.pth from RGB, original per-image normalization and PNG8 truncation; no GT depth supplied to generator
protocol.focus: Native predicted PNG8 depth at one click /255
protocol.K: Benchmark K4/8/16/32 unchanged; abs(predicted_depth-focus)*K/32; native focused condition<=0.1
protocol.prompt_reason: Original official demo prompt, used equally for all three preflight candidates; previous native batch Table3 uses empty prompt
protocol.generator: Unchanged author FP16 model;512px tiles, stride256, overlap reconstruction, original PIL/AdaIN conversion
protocol.RNG: Seed42+25*manifest_scene_index+frame_index for every frame; same seed across candidates, independent of shard/order, no temporal smoothing
protocol.coverage_and_leakage: Visible target alpha>0.5; GPU native focused mask; complement defines non-target; report separately byK
protocol.selection: A preferred; B diagnostic, no PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS or bokeh-GT based selection; inspect correct visible click, margins, native control coverage/leakage and finite outputs
protocol.full_run_start: After5000-frame visibility inventory,40-frame three-candidate review and explicit recorded adapter freeze; preserve all failures and information permissions

preflight.scope: GT visible target alpha only chooses one control point; generator RGB and native predicted geometry retained; no temporal smoothing
preflight.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

full_runner_check.scope: Fresh depth+generator process; cached preflight conditioning replays exact B output; native depth inference also compared

frame.target_eval_mask: Visible target alpha >0.5; complement defines non-target

instance_check.scope: Source object index checked as well as source ID; repeated source assets are distinct instances

frozen_protocol.name: MagicBokeh Target-guided Point-Focus / Depth-Medoid B
frozen_protocol.authorization: User explicitly selected B after40-frame three-candidate control/visual review on2026-09-30; disclose target-region predicted-depth assisted point selection
frozen_protocol.target: Designated object from metadata; visible alpha=object alpha times all nearer-layer transmittances
frozen_protocol.click_region: Visible alpha>0.9, then>0.5, then>0 if empty; largest8-connected component; boundaries zero padded
frozen_protocol.point: Pixel of native PNG8 depth nearest safe-region median; ties greatest exact Euclidean boundary distance, then row-major
frozen_protocol.model_input_permission: RGB and one target-guided click; visible GT target alpha and native predicted depth assist point selection outside model. No GT numeric depth, mask, alpha or hidden RGB fed to generator
frozen_protocol.depth: Official DAdepth.pth / ViT-L from RGB; infer_image input_size518, per-image minmax plus1e-8, truncate toPNG8
frozen_protocol.focus: Native predicted PNG8 depth at selected point /255, not region median scalar
frozen_protocol.K: Manifest K unchanged; abs(native_depth-focus)*K/32; focus mask<=0.1
frozen_protocol.generator: Unchanged FP16 official model;512x512 tiles, stride256, original overlap reconstruction and PIL/AdaIN output
frozen_protocol.temporal: Independent frame inference, no propagation/smoothing; same semantic object selected perframe
frozen_protocol.RNG: Seed42+25*manifest_scene_index+frame_index immediately before six native tile calls; preflight/full and worker order independent
frozen_protocol.visibility_inventory: 5000/5000 have safe visible alpha>0.9; zero unavailable frames; no semantic instance changes
frozen_protocol.preflight_reuse: Forty B outputs and native depth conditions reused; exact generator replay checked before full run
frozen_protocol.quality_scope: Paired public-proxy reproduction development; GT-guided control permission disclosed; no claim of same-geometry or automatic autofocus comparison
frozen_protocol.failure_policy: Keep K32 partial-target defocus and native depth variation; no K/gamma/threshold search or depth replacement

findings: A and B clicks are inside the benchmark-designated visible target on all40 frames.
repro_000 A clicks lion face, native predicted depth is high near face and lower over body; focus mask covers a small facial patch, body defocus remains in output.
B enlarges the targeted lion focused region, while partial-target defocus remains; K32 repro_001 has native geometry/control changes across selected frames.
LowK focused masks often include most of the image at unchanged native threshold; multiple objects and boundaries remain method limitations.
visual_review.boundary: Five separated keyframes perclip, not continuous25-frame temporal review; no paired bokeh quality metrics used to choose adapter

selection.user_explicit_choice: 改用 B，披露目标区域深度辅助选点
selection.basis: Control diagnostics and native interface, not PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS; A stability premise did not hold forK32 repro_000

corrected_implementation_issue: Initial frozen-runner check called PIL.size as a method in an output audit. Corrected to the property before formal inference; replay then passed; failed check log retained.
